questions.question:
An administrator wants to configure dead peer detection (DPD) on IPsec
VPN for detecting dead tunnels. The requirement is that FortiGate sends DPD probes
only when there is no inbound traffic.
Which DPD mode on FortiGate meets this requirement?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Enabled
options.B: On Idle
options.C: Disabled
options.D: On Demand

questions.question:
Which two statements about equal-cost multi-path (ECMP) configuration
on FortiGate are true?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: If SD-WAN is enabled, you control the load balancing algorithm with the parameter load-balance-mode.
options.B: If SD-WAN is disabled, you can configure the parameter v4-ecmp-mode to volume-based.
options.C: If SD-WAN is enabled, you can configure routes with unequal distance and priority values to be part of ECMP
options.D: If SD-WAN is disabled, you configure the load balancing algorithm in config system settings.

questions.question:
You have created a web filter profile named restrict_media-profile with a
daily category usage quota.
When you are adding the profile to the firewall policy, the restrict_media-profile is not
listed in the available web profile drop down.
What could be the reason?
.
(Choose one answer)

options.A: The firewall policy is in no-inspection mode instead of deep-inspection.
options.B: The inspection mode in the firewall policy is not matching with web filter profile feature set.
options.C: The web filter profile is already referenced in another firewall policy.
options.D: The naming convention used in the web filter profile is restricting it in the firewall policy

options.C: The resources utilization is optimized because these websites are in the trusted domain list on FortiGate.
options.D: The legal regulation aims to prioritize user privacy and protect sensitive information for these websites.

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit.
The NOC team connects to the FortiGate GUI with the NOC_Access admin profile. They
request that their GUI sessions do not disconnect too early during inactivity.

team?

options.A: Move NOC_Access to the top of the list to ensure all profile settings take effect.
options.B: Increase the offline value of the Override Idle Timeout parameter in the NOC_Access admin profile.
options.C: Ensure that all NOC_Access users are assigned the super_admin role to guarantee access.
options.D: Increase the admintimeout value under config system accprofile NOC_Access.

options.D: FortiGate drops new sessions requiring inspection.

questions.question:
What is the primary FortiGate election process when the HA override
setting is enabled?

options.A: Connected monitored ports > Priority > HA uptime > FortiGate serial number
options.B: Connected monitored ports > Priority > System uptime > FortiGate serial number
options.C: Connected monitored ports > HA uptime > Priority > FortiGate serial number
options.D: Connected monitored ports > System uptime > Priority > FortiGate serial number

questions.question:
An administrator wanted to configure an IPS sensor to block traffic that
triggers a signature a set number of times during a specific time period.
How can the administrator achieve the objective?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Use IPS group signatures, set rate-mode 60.
options.B: Use IPS packet logging option with periodical filter option.
options.C: Use IPS filter, rate-mode periodical option.
options.D: Use IPS signatures, rate-mode periodical option.

questions.question:
A FortiGate firewall policy is configured with active authentication,
however, the user cannot authenticate when accessing a website.
Which protocol must FortiGate allow even though the user cannot authenticate?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: LDAP
options.B: TACACS+
options.C: Kerberos
options.D: DNS

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit, which shows a partial configuration from the
remote authentication server.
Why does the FortiGate administrator need this configuration?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: To authenticate only the Training user group.
options.B: To set up a RADIUS server Secret.
options.C: To authenticate and match the Training OU on the RADIUS server.
options.D: To authenticate Any FortiGate user groups.

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit,
which shows an SD-WAN zone configuration on the FortiGate GUI.
Based on the exhibit, which statement is true?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: The Underlay zone is the zone by default.
options.B: The Underlay zone contains no member.
options.C: port2 and port3 are not assigned to a zone.
options.D: The virtual-wan-link and overlay zones can be deleted.

questions.question:
Which three statements explain a flow-based antivirus profile?
(Choose three answers)

options.A: FortiGate buffers the whole file but transmits to the client at the same time.
options.B: Flow-based inspection uses a hybrid of the scanning modes available in proxy-based inspection.
options.C: If a virus is detected, the last packet is delivered to the client.
options.D: Flow-based inspection optimizes performance compared to proxy-based inspection.
options.E: The IPS engine handles the process as a standalone.

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit.
An administrator has configured an Application Overrides for the ABC.Com application
signature and set the Action to Allow. This application control profile is then applied to
a firewall policy that is scanning all outbound traffic. Logging is enabled in the firewall
policy. To test the configuration, the administrator accessed the ABC.Com web site
several times.
Why are there no logs generated under security logs for ABC.Com?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: The ABC.Com Type is set as Application instead of Filter.
options.B: The ABC.Com is configured under application profile, which must be configured as a web filter profile.
options.C: The ABC.Com Action is set to Allow.
options.D: The ABC.Com is hitting the category Excessive-Bandwidth.

questions.question:
Which two statements describe characteristics of automation stitches?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: Actions involve only devices included in the Security Fabric.
options.B: An automation stitch can have multiple triggers.
options.C: Multiple actions can run in parallel.
options.D: Triggers can involve external connectors.

questions.question:
Which three statements about SD-WAN performance SLAs are true?
(Choose three answers)

options.A: They rely on session loss and jitter.
options.B: They can be measured actively or passively.
options.C: They are applied in a SD-WAN rule lowest cost strategy.
options.D: They monitor the state of the FortiGate device.
options.E: All the SLA targets can be configured.

questions.question:
Which two statements are true about an HA cluster?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: An HA cluster cannot have both in-band and out-of-band management interfaces at the same time.
options.B: Link failover triggers a failover if the administrator sets the interface down on the primary device.
options.C: When sniffing the heartbeat interface, the administrator must see the IP address 169.254.0.2.
options.D: HA incremental synchronization includes FIB entries and IPsec SAs.

questions.question:
A network administrator enabled antivirus and selected an SSL
inspection profile on a firewall policy.
When downloading an EICAR test file through HTTP, FortiGate detects the virus and
blocks the file. When downloading the same file through HTTPS, FortiGate does not
detect the virus and does not block the file, allowing it to be downloaded.
The administrator confirms that the traffic matches the configured firewall policy.
What are two reasons for the failed virus detection by FortiGate?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: The selected SSL inspection profile has certificate inspection enabled.
options.B: The website is exempted from SSL inspection.
options.C: The EICAR test file exceeds the protocol options oversize limit.
options.D: The browser does not trust the FortiGate self-signed CA certificate.

questions.question:
You have configured the below commands on a FortiGate.
What would be the impact of this configuration on FortiGate?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: FortiGate will enable strict RPF on all its interfaces and port1 will be enable for asymmetric routing.
options.B: FortiGate will enable strict RPF on all its interfaces and port1 will be exempted from RPF checks.
options.C: Port1 will be enabled with flexible RPF, and all other interfaces will be enabled for strict RPF.
options.D: The global configuration will take precedence and FortiGate will enable strict RPF on all interfaces.

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit.
What would be the impact of these settings on the Server certificate SNI check
configuration on FortiGate?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: FortiGate will accept and use the CN in the server certificate for URL filtering if the SNI does not match the CN or SAN fields.
options.B: FortiGate will accept the connection with a warning if the SNI does not match the CN or SAN fields.
options.C: FortiGate will close the connection if the SNI does not match the CN or SAN fields.
options.D: FortiGate will close the connection if the SNI does not match the CN and SAN fields.

questions.question:
A new administrator is configuring FSSO authentication on FortiGate
using DC Agent Mode.
Which step is NOT part of the expected process?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: The DC agent sends login event data directly to FortiGate.
options.B: The user logs into the windows domain.
options.C: The collector agent forwards login event data to FortiGate.
options.D: FortiGate determines user identity based on the IP address in the FSSO list.

questions.question:
A network administrator is reviewing firewall policies in both Interface
Pair View and By Sequence View. The policies appear in a different order in each view.
Why is the policy order different in these two views?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Policies in Interface Pair View are prioritized by security levels, while By Sequence View strictly follows the administrator's manual ordering.
options.B: By Sequence View groups policies based on rule priority, while Interface Pair View always follows the order of traffic logs.
options.C: The firewall dynamically reorders policies in Interface Pair View based on recent traffic patterns, but By Sequence View remains static.
options.D: Interface Pair View sorts policies based on matching interfaces, while By Sequence View shows the actual processing order of rules.

questions.question:
An administrator notices that some users are unable to establish SSL
VPN connections, while others can connect without any issues.
What should the administrator check first?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Ensure that the affected users are using the correct port number
options.B: Ensure that user traffic is hitting the firewall policy
options.C: Ensure that forced tunneling is enabled to reroute all traffic through the SSL VPN
options.D: Ensure that the HTTPS service is enabled on SSL VPN tunnel interface

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit.
An administrator has created a new firewall address to use as the destination for a
static route.
Why is the administrator not able to select the new address in the Destination field of
the new static route?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: In the new static route, the administrator must select Named Address.
options.B: In the new firewall address, the FQDN address must first be resolved.
options.C: In the new static route, the administrator must first set the interface to port2.
options.D: In the new firewall address, Routing configuration must be enabled.

questions.question:
FortiGate is operating in NAT mode and has two physical interfaces
connected to the LAN and DMZ networks respectively.
Which two statements about the requirements of connected physical interfaces on
FortiGate are true?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: Both interfaces must have the interface role assigned.
options.B: Both interfaces must have directly connected routes on the routing table.
options.C: Both interfaces must have DHCP enabled and interfaces set to LAN and DMZ roles assigned.
options.D: Both interfaces must have IP addresses assigned.

questions.question:
When configuring a FortiGate in a multi-WAN setup, why would an
administrator enable session preservation on an interface?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: To allow the FortiGate to dynamically change interfaces for all active sessions when a WAN link fails
options.B: To make sure all sessions without source NAT enabled always use the primary WAN link
options.C: To improve security by forcing users to authenticate again when the WAN link changes
options.D: To ensure that existing SSL VPN connections remain on the same interface even if route changes occur

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibit.
FortiGate has two separate firewall policies for Sales and Engineering to access the
same web server with the same security profiles.
Which action must the administrator perform to consolidate the two policies into one?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Create an Aggregate interface that includes port1 and port2 to create a single firewall policy.
options.B: Select port1 and port2 subnets in a single firewall policy.
options.C: Replace port1 and port2 with the any interface in a single firewall policy.
options.D: Enable Multiple Interface Policies to select port1 and port2 in the same firewall policy.

questions.question:
You have configured an application control profile, set peer-to-peer
traffic to Block under the Categories tab, and applied it to the firewall policy. However,
your peer-to-peer traffic on known ports is passing through the FortiGate without
being blocked.
What FortiGate settings should you check to resolve this issue?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: FortiGuard category ratings
options.B: Application and Filter Overrides
options.C: Network Protocol Enforcement
options.D: Replacement Messages for UDP-based Applications

questions.question:
When configuring firewall policies which of the following is true
regarding the policy ID?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: It is mandatory to provide a policy ID while creating a firewall policy regardless of GUI or CLI.
options.B: A firewall policy ID identifies the order of policy execution in firewall policies.
options.C: You can create a policy in CLI with policy ID 0.
options.D: A policy ID cannot be edited once a policy is created.

questions.question:
Which two statements are correct when FortiGate enters conserve
mode?

options.A: FortiGate continues to run critical security actions, such as quarantine.
options.B: FortiGate refuses to accept configuration changes.
options.C: FortiGate halts complete system operation and requires a reboot to regain available resources.
options.D: FortiGate continues to transmit packets without IPS inspection when the fail-open global setting in IPS is enabled.

questions.question:
A remote user reports slow SSL VPN performance and frequent
disconnections. The user is located in an area with poor internet connectivity.
What setting should the administrator adjust to improve the user’s experience?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Enable split tunneling to reduce VPN traffic.
options.B: Change the SSL VPN port to a non-standard port.
options.C: Increase the session timeout for inactive sessions.
options.D: Configure the DTLS timeout to accommodate high-latency connections.

questions.question:
An administrator wants to analyze and manage digital certificates to
prevent browser warnings when users connect to the SSL VPN portal.
Which two statements describe how to correctly do this?
(Choose two answers)

options.A: The administrator can rely on the default FortiGate self-signed certificate to prevent all security warnings in the browser.
options.B: The administrator must disable HTTPS administrative access entirely to avoid certificate warnings.
options.C: The administrator can use a publicly trusted certificate from a known certificate authority (CA) to stop browser warnings.
options.D: The administrator can import the FortiGate self-signed certificate into each user’s browser as a trusted certificate.

questions.question:
An administrator suspects that the Collector Agent is not forwarding
login events to FortiGate.
What is the most effective troubleshooting step?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Verify if DC agent is enabled on the FortiGate
options.B: Restart the domain controller to refresh authentication services.
options.C: Verify if FortiGate is set to use LDAP authentication instead of FSSO.
options.D: Check if TCP port 8000 is open between the collector agent and FortiGate.

options.C: On BR1-FGT, set Remote Address to 10.0.11.0/255.255.255.0.
options.D: On HQ-NGFW, set Encryption to AES256.

as the firewall policy and IP pool configuration on the FortiGate device.

successfully. However, when the administrator adds a third PC to the network (PC3),
the PC cannot connect to the internet.

the administrator use to fix the connectivity issue for PC3?

options.A: In the system settings, set Multiple Interface Policies to enable.
options.B: In the IP pool configuration, set endip to 100.65.0.112.
options.C: In the firewall policy, set match-vip to enable using CLI.

options.B: HQ-NGFW-2 with the parameter priority setting
options.C: HQ-NGFW-1 with the parameter memory-failover-flip-timeout setting
options.D: HQ-NGFW-1 with the parameter override setting

options.A: Whether the user is assigned to the correct AD group.
options.B: The FortiGate firewall policy settings for SSL decryption.
options.C: . The FortiGate FSSO active users list for user's IP address.
options.D: The Windows event viewer for failed login attempts.

questions.question:
What are three key routing principles in SD-WAN?

options.A: By default, SD-WAN rules are skipped if the included SD-WAN members do not have a valid route to the destination.
options.B: SD-WAN rules have precedence over any other type of routes.
options.C: Regular policy routes have precedence over SD-WAN rules.
options.D: By default, SD-WAN rules are skipped if only one route to the destination is available.
options.E: By default, SD-WAN rules are skipped if the best route to the destination is not an SD-WAN member.

questions.question:
Refer to the exhibits.
An administrator configured the Web Filter Profile to block access to all social
networking sites except Facebook. However, when users try to access facebook.com,
they are redirected to a FortiGuard web filtering block page.

allow Facebook while blocking all other social networking sites?
(Choose one answer)

options.A: Change the Feature set of Web Filter Profile as Proxy-based.
options.B: Change the type as Simple in the Static URL Filter section.
options.C: Set the Action as Exempt for www.facebook.com in the Static URL Filter.
options.D: Set the Social Networking action as warning in the FortiGuard Category Based Filter.

HTTP, and HTTPS.

block the file download over HTTPS.

(Choose one answer)

options.A: Web filter is not enabled on the firewall policy to complement the antivirus profile.
options.B: The feature set in the antivirus profile is not set to Flow-based.
options.C: The SSL inspection mode in the firewall policy is not deep content inspection.
options.D: The action on the firewall policy is not set to deny.

questions.question:

questions.question:

Based on the current HA status, an administrator updates the override and priority
parameters on HQ-NGFW-1 and HQ-NGFW-2 as shown in the exhibit.
